description: Beyond-PCAF whole-life allowances (B2/B5/B8). VOLUNTARY ANNEX - never enters the PCAF roll-up.

referenceStudyPeriod_years.reference: RICS Whole Life Carbon Assessment for the Built Environment, 2nd ed - 60-yr reference study period

b2Maintenance_kgCO2e_m2.reference: GLA 'Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessments Guidance' (London Plan) - design-stage maintenance figure of 10 kgCO2e/m2 GIA covering all element categories (alternatively 1% of A1-A5, whichever greater). Method 1 (per-m2 allowance) adopted.

b5Refurbishment_kgCO2e_m2.reference: INDICATIVE allowance - Method 1 (per-m2). HONESTY FLAG: B5 has no single strong standard source (unlike B2's GLA-backed 10). B5 is discretionary and often omitted in practice.
b5Refurbishment_kgCO2e_m2.gap: Defensible upgrade is Method 2 (% of upfront A1-A5), which activates with the embodied layer (PR-02b).

b8Unregulated.reference: DISABLED. B8 is NOT a module in ISO 21930:2017 or EN 15978 for buildings (those run B1-B7 only). B8 'user utilization of infrastructure' comes from EN 15804 / infrastructure standards. For a building it has no defined module and no robust factor; unregulated/plug loads belong in B6. Disabled to avoid false precision and double-counting with B6.
b8Unregulated.activation: Real only for user-carrying infrastructure (road/rail): B8 = traffic x vehicle EF x years. Manual entry only.
